prompt: How does the iOS vendor login endpoint work?
response: POST /api/auth/vendor/login with Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Body: 'username={email}&password={password}'. Returns P2PLoginResponse with accessToken, tokenType, user (P2PUser: id, email, fullName, role, vendorId). Token stored in Keychain + UserDefaults (vendorId, vendorName, vendorEmail). Source: P2PAPIService.swift:1117-1200.

prompt: How does iOS vendor registration work?
response: POST /api/auth/vendor/register with JSON body: {email, password, full_name, restaurant_name}. Returns P2PLoginResponse. Note: Uses full_name for owner name, restaurant_name for business name. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:1202-1337.

prompt: How does iOS vendor Google sign-in work?
response: POST /api/auth/vendor/google-auth with JSON body: {email, name, google_id}. Returns P2PLoginResponse. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:1338-1427.

prompt: How does iOS vendor Apple sign-in work?
response: POST /api/auth/vendor/apple-auth with JSON body: {email, name, apple_id, identity_token (optional)}. Returns P2PLoginResponse. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:1428-1515.

prompt: What iOS restaurant menu management endpoints exist?
response: GET /api/vendors/{vendorId}/menu (list items, P2PAPIService.swift:252). POST /api/vendors/{vendorId}/menu (create item, 299). PATCH /api/vendors/{vendorId}/menu/{itemId} (update item, 363). DELETE /api/vendors/{vendorId}/menu/{itemId} (delete item, 417). GET /api/vendors/{vendorId}/menu/categories (get categories, 464). POST /api/vendors/{vendorId}/menu/assign-stock-images (auto-assign images, 1004). All require vendorToken.

prompt: What is the P2PMenuItem model in iOS?
response: P2PMenuItem (P2PAPIService.swift:7755-7787): id (Int), name (String, encoded as 'item_name'), description (String?), category (String?), price (Double), imageUrl (String?), isVegetarian (Bool), isVegan (Bool), isGlutenFree (Bool), isSpicy (Bool), spiceLevel (Int), prepTime (Int?), calories (Int?), inStock (Bool), customizations ([P2PMenuItemCustomization]?). CodingKey maps 'name' to 'item_name' in JSON.

prompt: What is the P2PMenuItemCreate model in iOS?
response: P2PMenuItemCreate (P2PAPIService.swift:7811-7861): Required: itemName (String), category (String), price (Double). Optional: description, isAvailable (default true), isVegetarian/isVegan/isGlutenFree/isSpicy (default false), spiceLevel (default 0), prepTime (Int?), calories (Int?), imageUrl (String?), inStock (default true), dailyLimit (Int?). Used for POST /api/vendors/{vendorId}/menu.

prompt: What iOS restaurant promotion endpoints exist?

DELETE /api/promotions/{promotionId} (delete, 781). GET /api/promotions/suggestions/{vendorId} (AI suggestions, 814). GET /api/promotions/analytics/{vendorId} (analytics, 855). POST /api/promotions/quick-create/{vendorId}/{promoType} (quick create, 963). All require vendorToken.

prompt: What is the P2PPromotion model in iOS?
response: P2PPromotion (P2PAPIService.swift:7919-7934): id (Int), promotionCode (String), vendorId (Int), name (String), description (String?), type (String: percentage/flat_amount/bogo/free_delivery/free_item/bundle), value (Double), maxDiscount (Double?), minOrderAmount (Double?), status (String), startDate (String?), endDate (String?), usageCount (Int?), totalDiscountGiven (Double?).

prompt: What iOS restaurant order management endpoints exist?

POST /api/erp/orders/{id}/restaurant-decline (decline order, 3251). POST /api/erp/orders/{id}/restaurant-accept-delivery (self-deliver, 3292). POST /api/erp/orders/{id}/restaurant-decline-delivery (request driver, 3326). POST /api/erp/orders/{id}/delivered (mark delivered, 3360). prompt: What is the iOS restaurant AI insights endpoint?
response: GET /api/vendors/{vendorId}/ai-insights?period={period} with vendorToken. Period: 'today', 'week', 'month', 'year'. Returns P2PAIInsightsResponse: totalOrders, totalRevenue, averageOrderValue, orderCompletionRate, averagePrepTimeMinutes, estimatedOrdersNextHour, peakHour, peakHourOrders, forecastConfidence, demandForecast (hourly), popularItems, hourlyDistribution, staffingRecommendations, recommendations (AI tips with priority/impact), lunchPeak, dinnerPeak. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:903, model at 8050-8110.

prompt: What iOS restaurant document endpoints exist?
response: GET /api/vendors/{vendorId}/documents (list documents, P2PAPIService.swift:7423). POST /api/vendors/{vendorId}/documents (upload multipart, 7469). DELETE /api/vendors/{vendorId}/documents/{documentId} (delete, 7550). Document types: food_license, health_permit, w9_form, insurance. P2PVendorDocument: id, documentType, fileName, fileUrl, uploadedAt, status (pending/approved/rejected), adminNotes. All require vendorToken.

prompt: What screens does the iOS restaurant app have?
response: Main tabs (EnhancedDashboardView): 1) Orders (OrdersDashboardView - status bar, quick stats, filter tabs, online toggle), 2) Menu (EnhancedMenuView - stats bar, search, category tabs, add/edit/delete items), 3) Analytics (AnalyticsView - time period selector, revenue/orders/avg charts, popular items, peak hours), 4) AI Insights (AIInsightsView - demand forecast, staffing recommendations, AI tips), 5) Settings (RestaurantSettingsView - profile, hours, notifications, Stripe Connect, documents, account deletion). Also: LoginView, RestaurantDocumentsView.

prompt: How does the iOS restaurant order status flow work?
response: OrdersViewModel organizes by status: newOrders (pending_restaurant, confirmed, placed), preparingOrders (accepted, preparing), readyOrders (ready_for_pickup, ready, pending_delivery_decision), selfDeliveryOrders (restaurant_will_deliver), deliveringOrders (restaurant_will_deliver, ontheway, pickedup), completedOrders (delivered, pickedup, ontheway), actionRequiredOrders (pending_restaurant, pending_delivery_decision). Restaurant must act on pending_restaurant (3-min window) and pending_delivery_decision (3-min window). Source: OrdersViewModel.swift:68-138.

prompt: How does iOS restaurant calculate today's revenue?
response: OrdersViewModel.todayRevenue filters orders by: (1) created today, (2) status is delivered/pickedup/ontheway/restaurant_will_deliver/out_for_delivery. Sums order.total for matching orders. todayOrderCount counts the same filtered set. Source: OrdersViewModel.swift:140-162.

prompt: What is the iOS restaurant online/offline toggle?
response: GET/SET /api/vendors/{vendorId}/online-status?is_online={true|false} with vendorToken. When offline, restaurant stops receiving new orders. Toggled from OrdersDashboardView header. Updates Vendor.is_online in backend. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:3170.

prompt: What iOS restaurant menu verification endpoints exist?
response: GET /api/menu-verification/status/{vendorId} (check verification status, P2PAPIService.swift:1043). POST /api/menu-verification/approve-all/{vendorId} (approve all items, 1077). The verify endpoint is public (no auth required). The approve-all is for AI employee (Aria). Admin can also approve/reject/flag individual items via /api/admin/menu/{itemId}/approve|reject|flag.

prompt: What permissions does the iOS restaurant app request?
response: Location When In Use (restaurant address, delivery estimates), Camera (menu item photos, interior photos), Photo Library (menu/restaurant image uploads). NO background location, NO microphone. Source: Info.plist:59-63. Entitlements: push notifications (production), Apple Sign-In. Source: eatffairrestaurant.entitlements.
